title: Self-Harness: Harnesses That Improve Themselves
abstract: arXiv:2606.09498v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The performance of LLM-based agents is jointly shaped by their base models and the harnesses that mediate their interaction with the environment. Because different models exhibit distinct behaviors, effective harness design is inherently model-specific. Yet agent harnesses are still largely engineered by human experts, a paradigm that scales poorly as modern LLMs become increasingly diverse and rapidly evolving. In this paper, we introduce Self-Harness, a new paradigm in which an LLM-based agent improves its own operating harness, without relying on human engineers or stronger external agents. We operationalize Self-Harness as an iterative loop with three stages: Weakness Mining, which identifies model-specific failure patterns from execution traces; Harness Proposal, which generates diverse yet minimal harness modifications tied to these failures; and Proposal Validation, which accepts candidate edits only after regression testing.

translated_title: 自我驾驭：能自我改进的驾驭机制
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.09498v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：基于LLM的代理的性能由其基础模型和调节其与环境交互的驾驭机制共同塑造。由于不同模型表现出不同的行为，有效的驾驭设计本质上具有模型特异性。然而，代理的驾驭机制仍主要由人类专家设计，这种范式在现代LLM日益多样化和快速发展的背景下扩展性不佳。在本文中，我们引入了自我驾驭（Self-Harness），这是一种新范式，其中基于LLM的代理能够改进其自身的操作驾驭机制，无需依赖人类工程师或更强外部代理。我们将自我驾驭实现为一个迭代循环，包含三个阶段：弱点挖掘（Weakness Mining），从执行轨迹中识别模型特定的失败模式；驾驭提议（Harness Proposal），生成与这些失败相关的多样化但最小化的驾驭修改；以及提议验证（Proposal Validation），仅在回归测试通过后接受候选编辑。
tldr: 本文提出一种新范式“自我驾驭”，让基于LLM的代理通过迭代循环自主改进其操作机制，无需人类或更强外部代理介入。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a new paradigm, Self-Harness, enabling LLM-based agents to autonomously improve their operational harnesses through an iterative loop, without human or stronger external assistance.
